commit_756a29ac_analysis.message: validation iter-22: activity_recommendation resolver activated; substrate restarted; create-shape-provider-goal unblocked
commit_756a29ac_analysis.what_was_blocking_create_shape_provider_: The create-shape-provider-goal template requires an 'activity_recommendation' resolver to select the best shape-producer candidate. This resolver was NOT registered in GoalHost's built-in registry prior to commit 156f1c30. All executions failed with task_count=0 in ~0ms because the resolver was undefined. Fix: 156f1c30 adds registerBuiltinResolvers() to goal-host-vessel startup — registers activity_recommendation as pattern-tier resolver forwarding to activity-api /v2/activities/recommend.
commit_756a29ac_analysis.validator_claim_unblocked: PARTIALLY CORRECT — the resolver is now registered. However, live substrate still shows create-shape-provider-goal at n=35, α=1, β=2, 0 successes, avg_dur=0.19ms. The new executions post-restart have not yet appeared (35 is same count as iter-011 at 09:10:48). The resolver registration is confirmed but first successful execution not yet observed.

f031_f057_root_cause_confirmed.finding: SIGTERM root cause identified: boredom-vessel.service has 'Requires=goal-host-vessel.service'. When goal-host-vessel stops (for any reason — LLM timeout, OOM, or manual restart), systemd propagates STOP to boredom-vessel via the Requires dependency. This is NOT the 300s TimeoutStartSec.
evidence: goal-host-vessel stopped at 09:17:04Z → boredom-vessel immediately SIGTERMed at 09:17:04Z
goal-host-vessel stopped at 09:02:56Z → boredom-vessel[1998] SIGTERMed at 09:02:56Z
The SIGTERM interval matches goal-host-vessel restart cycle (~13 min: 09:03:36 → 09:17:04)
f031_f057_root_cause_confirmed.goal_host_restart_reason: Unknown — goal-host-vessel ran from 09:03:36Z to 09:17:04Z (13m28s), consuming 7.492s CPU. Could be LLM completion timeout, OOM, or internal error. No error log visible.
f031_f057_root_cause_confirmed.fix: Change boredom-vessel.service to 'Wants=goal-host-vessel.service' (not Requires) OR add 'Restart=on-failure' with boredom checking for goal-host availability before dispatching (already does check but exits with code 1 on failure).
